objective: Derive the OmniSim pilot run identity from the verified world digest and the step count instead of uuid4, and record that digest in the artifact metadata.
decision_supported: Should the pilot run identity be a random value, or a hash of the world it loaded and the probe it performed?
acceptance: The same world and step count produce the same run id.
A different world changes the id.
A different step count changes the id.
A missing world reports unavailable rather than raising.
The published metadata records world_digest next to world_path.
uuid4 is no longer used to name a run.
evidence: Before the change run_id was f'omnisim-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}', so the same world path and step count produced a different directory on every invocation.
After the change two runs of the same world and step count share a run id, and changing either input changes it.
The metadata now carries world_digest, so an artifact can be tied to the world revision it loaded; the existing world_path field is unchanged.
stop_conditions: The world lives on the simulator host rather than the local filesystem; the digest then reports unavailable and the id falls back to the step count alone, which the metadata makes visible.
risks_and_fallbacks: Two probes of the same world now write to the same directory name, so a second run into one output_dir collides rather than adding a sibling; the caller chooses the output directory per invocation.
The digest is of the local file, not of what the simulator loaded; a mismatch between them is a property of the loader, not of this identity.
